title: Trash folder
whyItMatters: Deleted files are not gone: the Trash keeps the full contents plus a metadata file with the original path and deletion time. Emptying the Trash is a separate step people often skip before selling a computer.
source: freedesktop.org Trash spec: trashed files live in $XDG_DATA_HOME/Trash with files/ and info/ subfolders: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/trash-spec/latest/
notes: files/ holds the trashed content and info/ one .trashinfo per item with its original path. Deletions on other mounts go to a .Trash-<uid> folder at that mount's top, which this rule does not cover.

steps: Open the Trash in your file manager or desktop dock.
Click Empty Trash, or delete the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Permanently erases all files and folders previously moved to the Trash. They cannot be restored.
